name: Noz 17

menus.name: Bar Menu omakase
menus.note: Amuse-bouche, ten pieces of nigiri, a hand roll or thin roll, miso soup, tamago and dessert; extra pieces can be ordered at the end. Same menu at both counters; optional three-pour sake pairings (Signature or Prestige)

bookingOpens: Online on SevenRooms. The menu price is paid in full when booking; gratuity is not included.
cancellation: Bookings can be cancelled or moved with at least 72 hours' notice, for a refund less a 3% fee; within 72 hours the payment is kept. There is a ten-minute grace period for late arrivals, and after 30 minutes the booking counts as a no-show.
waitlist: Request a time on SevenRooms when the seating you want is full.
groups: Two counters: a seven-seat main counter (seatings 5:15pm, 7pm and 8:45pm, with chef Junichi Matsuzaki every night except Saturdays) and a four-seat counter (5:30pm, 7:15pm and 9pm, with a sous chef), which a party of four has to itself at no extra charge. More than five guests need a private buyout of the main counter (oshinobi@noz17.com).
byob: Corkage is $120 a bottle or $250 a magnum, up to two bottles or one magnum per party, and not for anything on the restaurant's list; ask before bringing one.
